boasVindas.vazio: This community has not written its welcome yet.
boasVindas.interessesDica: Pick one or more. The community suggests a starting point for each.
boasVindas.soNoAparelho: Your choice stays only on this device: it does not go to the database and nobody sees it.
boasVindas.semTexto: The community has not written a starting point for this one yet.

regras.pede: This community asks you to read and accept the rules before posting or replying here.
regras.aceitar: I have read and accept the rules
regras.mudaram: The rules changed since you accepted them. Read them again to keep posting.
regras.entreParaAceitar: Sign in to Alumia to accept the rules.

etiqueta.dica: It appears next to your posts in this community, and only here. The list belongs to the moderation; there is no page of who has each tag.
etiqueta.semLista: The moderation has not written tags for this community yet.
etiqueta.soMembro: Join the community to choose a tag.
etiqueta.oferta: The moderation offered you the tag “{nome}”. It only appears on your posts if you accept.
etiqueta.tirada: You have no tag here now.

meus.deixarPergunta: Leave the role “{nome}”? You lose what it allows right away.

cargos.dica: Someone with a role can do only what is ticked on it. Removing posts, banning, appointing moderators and creating roles stay with the moderation. Nobody holds a role without accepting.
cargos.vazio: This community has no roles yet.

pedidos.texto: Accept or decline who asks to join and write the request questions.

regras.texto: Write the rules and ask for them to be read before posting.

boas_vindas.texto: Write the welcome and the interests for newcomers.

etiquetas.texto: Look after post tags and people tags.

fixar.texto: Pin posts at the top and give the pin a deadline.

gestao.dica: You only see here what your role allows. Everything goes into the moderation log.
gestao.apagarPergunta: Delete the role “{nome}”? Whoever holds it will be told and loses what it allows.
gestao.descricao: What this role does (shown to everyone)
gestao.descricaoExemplo: E.g.: Welcomes newcomers and handles requests.
gestao.quemTem: Who holds it or was invited
gestao.convidou: Invitation sent. The role only counts after it is accepted.
gestao.boasCampo: Welcome (sent as a notice to whoever joins)
gestao.boasExemplo: Great to have you here. Read the rules and introduce yourself.
gestao.interesseTexto: The starting point the community suggests
gestao.interesseTextoExemplo: E.g.: Start with the wiki booklet.
gestao.regrasAntes: Ask for the rules to be read and accepted before posting
gestao.regrasAntesDica: When the rules change, those who had accepted accept again. The moderation does not need to accept.
gestao.oferecerDica: Only those the moderation offers. It counts after the person accepts.
gestao.semOferecer: No tag on the list is given by the moderation.
gestao.tirouEtiqueta: Tag removed. The person will be told.
gestao.fixadosDica: Once the deadline passes, the post leaves the top by itself.

antes.leia: Before posting in “{nome}”, read and accept the rules in the community's Arrival tab.
antes.compositor: This community asks for the rules to be accepted before posting.

cartao.rotulo: Tag of the author in this community

erros.leia_as_regras: This community asks you to accept the rules before posting. See the Arrival tab.
erros.sem_permissao: Your role here does not allow this.
erros.nao_encontrado: Not found. It may have changed already: reload.
erros.invalido:pessoa: That @name does not belong to someone in this community.
erros.invalido:nome_repetido: There is already one with that name.
erros.invalido:limite_de_cargos: This community already has the maximum number of roles.
erros.invalido:prazo: The deadline goes from 1 hour to 180 days.
erros.invalido:nome: The name must have 2 to 40 characters.
erros.limite: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a little.
erros.generico: It did not work right now. Try again.
